summary: `validate` overstates the invariants it checks; the remaining reviewed additions are comment-only and substantively aligned with their implementations.

items.issue: The documentation says this asserts the red-black tree invariants and throws if any invariant is violated, but the implementation never asserts that a non-empty top-level tree has a black root. A red-root tree with ordered keys, no red-red edge, and equal black heights passes validation.
items.suggestion: Describe only the properties actually checked, or explicitly state that root colour is not checked. Do not claim every red-black invariant is asserted.
